title: Reputation pages: NERD, GreyNoise Visualizer, FortiGuard, URLVoid, MultiRBL, HoneyLabs, CyberCrime-Tracker
notes: Offline data (disclosure 'none'): V3LUM never requests these URLs or any API behind them; it renders them for the analyst (P311). Rendering follows A2: at TLP:AMBER and above every link is non-clickable text with 'opening sends <value> to <host>', at RED third-party links are hidden from reports and listed only by `v3lum links`; links are never auto-opened. Links in 'links' are rendered by the core (v3lum.core.links); entries in 'x_module_links' need a gate the frozen core link model does not carry (TLP ceiling, analyst-typed values only, public-value filter, vetted encoder) and are rendered by the pack's module through v3lum.modules.utility.pivot_gated_links. File order is the curated analyst-value order (cond 6). Verified links carry checked_at; pivot_gated_links.recheck_report() lists unverified links and links older than 180 days (cond 7, the data of `v3lum doctor --links`).
